## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0, both signs

Step 3 of `investigations/tetralayer-stacking-fs-count.md`: fixed-(n, D=0) field sweeps to pin the SdH onset, the tone content, and which side is cleaner, before committing the fan. Run 6: electron, n = +3.2×10¹² (F_L = 33.1 T), B 0→10 T. Run 7: hole, n = −1.2×10¹² (F_L = 12.4 T), B 10→0.3 T ride-down. Raw first, then onset + 1/B FFT per run.

# Run 6 — raw first: MR at n = +3.2e12, D = 0 (electron), B 0 -> 10 T
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError  # not in the preamble import

r6 = run(6)
print(summarize_run(r6))
B6 = r6.col("magnet_field")
IBIAS = 1.0 / 100e6          # sr1 drive 1.0 V over 100 MOhm = 10 nA
R6 = r6.col("sr1_X") / IBIAS  # sr1 gain 1 (unity, device card)
T6 = r6.col("T_sample")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 3.6))
ax[0].plot(B6, R6, lw=0.6, color="#4053d3")
ax[0].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel=r"$R_{xx}$ ($\Omega$)", title="run 6 raw — n=+3.2e12, D=0")
ax[1].plot(B6, T6, lw=0.6, color="#4053d3")
ax[1].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="T_sample (K)", title="T during run 6")
fig.tight_layout()
print(f"R: {np.nanmin(R6):.1f}..{np.nanmax(R6):.1f} Ohm on 5 kOhm FS (max {np.nanmax(R6)/5e3*100:.0f}% FS, no rail)")
print(f"T_sample {np.nanmin(T6):.3f}..{np.nanmax(T6):.3f} K; "
      f"leakage tg/bg medians {np.nanmedian(r6.col('k_2400_tg_curr'))*1e12:+.0f}/{np.nanmedian(r6.col('k_2400_bg_curr'))*1e12:+.0f} pA")

# Run 6 — onset + 1/B FFT vs F_L (sdh-spot-check step 6)
FL6 = luttinger_frequency(3.2e16)  # n in m^-2 -> 33.1 T
i6 = np.argsort(B6)
Bs6, Rs6 = B6[i6], R6[i6]
on6 = sdh_onset(Rs6, Bs6, r_full_scale=50e-6 / IBIAS)
print(on6.summary())

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(13.5, 3.6))
m = Bs6 >= on6.onset_b
p = np.polyfit(Bs6[m], Rs6[m], 5)
ax[0].plot(Bs6[m], Rs6[m] - np.polyval(p, Bs6[m]), lw=0.5, color="#4053d3")
ax[0].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel=r"$\Delta R_{xx}$ ($\Omega$)", title=f"bg-subtracted (deg 5) above {on6.onset_b:.2f} T")
for cut, a in [(0.35, ax[1]), (1.0, ax[2])]:
    mm = Bs6 >= cut
    fr, sp = sdh_fft(Rs6[mm][:, None], Bs6[mm], b_range=(cut, Bs6.max()), bg_degree=5)
    a.plot(fr, sp[0], lw=0.8, color="#4053d3")
    a.axvline(FL6, color="#b51d14", ls="--", label=f"$F_L$ = {FL6:.1f} T")
    for k in (2, 3, 4):
        a.axvline(k * 7.1, color="0.6", ls=":", lw=0.8)
    a.set(xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="|FFT|", xlim=(0, 45), title=f"1/B FFT, cutoff {cut:.2f} T (dots: k x 7.1)")
    a.legend()
fig.tight_layout()

**Read (Step 3 verdict).** **Electron side is the fan side.** Run 6 is clean: a strong light tone at **7.1 T** (censored at the 0.3 T record edge — onset ≤ 0.3 T, a device-quality win) carrying a harmonic comb (14.1 / 22.1 / 29.5 ≈ 2×/3×/4×), no rail (max 10% FS at 50 µV), leakage quiet. Run 7 (hole) is the recipe's low-|n| exception regime — crowded, mutually-harmonic-flagged tones, onset 0.71 T, and the hole side can't reach design density (TG limit caps it at −1.27×10¹²): **uninformative for the stacking call, as the investigation predicts** — recorded, not pursued.

The single-column ambiguity the fan must break: **22.1 T is either the 3rd harmonic of 7.1 (21.3 T, within ~2·δF) or the real ABAB heavy tone** (7.1 + 22.1 = 29.2 T ≈ F_L at global scale 0.88; model pair at n = 3.2×10¹²: 7.31 / 25.78 T). The investigation's harmonic screen forbids a ratio-only call exactly here (ABAB ratio drifts through 3× with density — model: 3.53 → 4.8 → 9.8 at n = 3.2 → 2.0 → 1.2×10¹², while a harmonic stays locked at 3.00). **The n-trajectory decides → Landau fan next** (Step 4), electron side, D = 0, inheriting run 6's Δ(1/B) = 0.010 T⁻¹, 50 µV sensitivity, and onset ≤ 0.3 T.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side at D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`), n = +1.2 → +3.2×10¹², B 0.35 → 10 T

> **05:29** · landau-fan-vti electron D=0: n +1.2..+3.2e12 (121 pts) x B 0.35->10 T uniform-1/B (277 rows, d(1/B)=0.010); sr1 50 uV, tau 0.3 s, fast\_delay 1.8 s; ends held at 10 T · **ETA ~02:29 (+1d)** (≈21h)

The stacking call now hinges on one ambiguity the spot check cannot break (ana runs 6–7, verdict cell): run 6's 22.1 T tone is either the 3rd harmonic of the 7.1 T light tone (21.3 T, inside ~2·δF) or the real ABAB heavy tone (7.1 + 22.1 = 29.2 T ≈ F_L at global scale 0.88; model pair 7.31/25.78 T at n = 3.2×10¹²). The fan's F(n) trajectories decide: a harmonic tracks 3.00×f_light at every n, while the model's heavy/light ratio drifts 3.53 → 4.8 → 9.8 across n = 3.2 → 2.0 → 1.2×10¹², and the light pocket empties below ~1×10¹² (F_light → 0) while a real heavy tone rides up toward 0.95·F_L — maximal separation exactly over this window. ABCA instead predicts a singleton pinned at F_L(n) throughout. Hole side is not fanned: low-|n| exception regime, can't reach design density (ana verdict).

**Design (computed, `landau-fan` step 1 + investigation step 2):** Δ(1/B) = 0.0100 /T inherited from run 6 (3.0 samples/period at F_L = 33.1 T) → **277 rows** uniform-1/B, ascending 0.35 → 10 T (magnet sits at 0; B_lo just above the censored ≤ 0.3 T onset — δF = 0.363 T resolves 22.1 vs 21.3 at ~2.2·δF and gives the n = 1.6×10¹² partner (model 2.34 T) 6.4 periods, the binding partner floor). **121 n-points** = ray-Nyquist floor at B_lo (2.03 pts per 4-fold LL spacing at 0.35 T). Sensitivity fixed 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): worst corner n = 1.2×10¹² × 10 T measured 576 Ω = 12% FS (run 7). fast_delay 1.8 s = 6τ (τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, per-column-FFT settling). B_max = 10 T costs only ~7 rows beyond 6 T (uniform-1/B) and buys the ν = 8/12/16 layer-number ladder reach and the high-B half of the breakdown B-window split. Ends at **10 T, held** — descent is the next measurement's to spend (LK ladder or ride-down).

**Price:** ~19.4 h computed from run-5 per-point calibration (1.9 s/pt) + traverse 73 min; headline **~21 h** with the session's 5–10% overrun. **Checkpoints** (hera-watch armed): first rows ~15 min (leakage, rail, channel sanity); ~2 h raw-row health + light-tone emergence; ~6–7 h first per-column FFT (heavy-tone trackability, continue/adjust/abandon); ~13 h comb region (B > 1 T). Auto-bucket: gates inside validators, B ≤ 10 T cap, no T/Si moves.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`): electron side, D = 0, n = +1.2 -> +3.2e12 (121 pts) x B 0.35 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (277 rows) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
ns = np.linspace(3.2, 1.2, 121)          # 1e12 cm^-2, fast axis (n_hi -> n_lo), D = 0
Ds = np.zeros(len(ns))
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
print(f"n-line: n = {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 at D = 0; Vtg {Vtgs.min():+.4f}..{Vtgs.max():+.4f} V, "
      f"Vbg {Vbgs.min():+.4f}..{Vbgs.max():+.4f} V (validators [{TG_MIN},{TG_MAX}] / [{BG_MIN},{BG_MAX}])")

# --- slow field axis: uniform in 1/B, ascending 0.35 -> 10 T (magnet sits at 0; fan ends at 10 T, held deliberately) ---
B_LO, B_HI, N_B = 0.35, 10.0, 277
invB = np.linspace(1.0 / B_LO, 1.0 / B_HI, N_B)
B_vec = 1.0 / invB
d_invB = (1.0 / B_LO - 1.0 / B_HI) / (N_B - 1)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
print(f"B: {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, {N_B} rows, d(1/B) = {d_invB:.5f} /T "
      f"(Nyquist at F_L=33.1 T: {1/(d_invB*33.1):.2f} samples/period; dF = {1/(1/B_LO-1/B_HI):.3f} T)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.02), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.02 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- lock-in: fixed for the whole fan; settling floor tau = 0.3 s / 24 dB -> fast_delay 6*tau ---
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)   # 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA; worst corner (n=1.2e12, 10 T) measured 576 Ohm = 12% FS (run 7)
_tau, _slope = sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {_tau} s, slope {_slope} dB/oct (expect 0.3 / 24); drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA")
assert _tau == 0.3, f"tau changed: {_tau}"
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.8, 1.0        # 6*tau (per-column SdH-FFT fan, landau-fan step 7); gates retrace in slow_delay
I_TRIP = 1e-9

_eta_h = (N_B * (len(ns) * (FAST_DELAY + 0.10) + SLOW_DELAY + 3.0 + 0.7) + (B_HI - B_LO) / 0.137 * 60 + B_LO / 0.137 * 60) / 3600
print(f"predicted wall-clock ~{_eta_h:.1f} h (per-point 1.9 s from run-5 calibration; +5-10% overrun per session evidence)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron: n = +1.2..+3.2e12 (121) at D = 0 (run-5 cal), "
                  f"B 0.35 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (277), sr1 50 uV, fast_delay 1.8 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'electron side, D = 0: n = +1.20 to +3.20e12 cm^-2 (121 pts, paired n-line); '
              f'B = 0.35 -> 10 T uniform-1/B, 277 rows, d(1/B) = 0.0100 /T (inherits run-6 spot check); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'sr1 50 uV, tau 0.3 s / 24 dB, fast_delay 1.8 s (6 tau)')

magnet.field(B_LO)                        # blocking ramp ~2.6 min + 3 s driver settle
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg, Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr(5), k_bg.curr(6), sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"fan done/stopped: B held at {magnet.field():+.3f} T (deliberate — next step decides the descent), gates parked at 0")

              f'B 10 -> 0.3 T uniform-B 20 mT (ride-down); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')

s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.3 T — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
